policy: Frozen before any model prompt for this six-arm cohort. Same previous required quality; no new subjective threshold or ratio target.
required: Both named external members personally contribute to meaningful design before implementation
A implements; B reads actual artifact/source and personally runs tests or boundary checks
Any reported blocking finding is resolved and actually re-reviewed; B explicitly accepts or documents unresolved findings
A provides a final delivery account after review; no evaluator-supplied recovery, code or relay
All original external40 checks pass and participant-provided self-tests pass
Both members retain one continuous session, exact approved model/effort and verified automatic-memory policy
Complete native per-response accounting and product reconciliation; no unaccounted native child work
All owned test processes/panes are cleaned; formal product data and caller pane preserved
qualityReviewMethod: Lead reads actual public handoffs and native tool records; external40 oracle independent of agents; no blind review claimed
failureRule: Preserve every attempt and all consumption. Equal-quality cohort multiplier is null unless all planned teams meet all requirements. Descriptive all-attempt totals remain available.
